answer_1.quote: We finetune and evaluate several open-source LLMs namely LLaMA-3-8b-Instruct, gemma-7B-it, and Qwen1.5-7B-Chat ... to generate coherent responses to user instructions while controlling response length.
answer_1.outputs: Instruction-following responses with controlled word count

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our results using the Conditioning Precision Ratio (CPR) metric, which measures how accurately models follow response length instructions. We also define CPR @k and calculate win‑rates between model outputs and a prompt baseline.

answer_3.quote: To gauge whether CIE leads to language generation degradation, we calculate win rates between the generation from CIE models and the "best" prompt baseline... The model used for judging was GPT-4 and the prompt used is shown in Listing H.1.
